name: Clickio Consent
author: Clickio

sections.description:
Clickio Consent allows you to comply with privacy regulations, TCF and Consent mode requirements.

• Google and IAB Certified
• Built-in Paywall & Paywall Integration
• Consent Mode v2 Support
• Easy-to-Use and Customizable
• Implement in minutes

Clickio Consent offers real-time consent reporting and multi-language support for seamless compliance.

No Publicly Documented Resource for Your Compressed Content

tcf.js
Clickio Consent implements the official CMP API v2 code maintained by IAB Tech Lab. The original, human-readable source code for this API is publicly available here:
https://github.com/InteractiveAdvertisingBureau/GDPR-Transparency-and-Consent-Framework/blob/master/TCFv2/IAB%20Tech%20Lab%20-%20CMP%20API%20v2.md
The CMP API v2 serves as an interface for CMPs, allowing web and in-app callers to access transparency and consent data disclosed by the CMP, in compliance with GDPR requirements for digital advertising. IAB Europe established this framework to enable the creation and management of consent data in a consistent, GDPR-compliant manner. The framework includes four components: ,Global Vendor List (GVL), Transparency and Consent String (TC String) for storing consent data, API for creating and processing the TC String, Policies that govern TCF use.
This structure facilitates publishers’ compliance with GDPR in digital advertising contexts.

Undocumented Use of a Third-Party / External Service

The Clickio Consent plugin loads the relevant Clickio CMP javascript code from clickiocmp.com, a domain owned and maintained by Clickio (the plugin’s developer). This code enables the display of the appropriate consent dialog, depending on user’s location and site’s settings, collects privacy choices from website visitors, and communicates these choices to vendors integrated with the site.
The plugin’s functionality depends on the following frameworks to relay user consent information to activated vendors:
IAB Transparency and Consent Framework – Learn more: https://iabtechlab.com/gpp/
IAB Global Privacy Platform – Learn more: https://github.com/InteractiveAdvertisingBureau/Global-Privacy-Platform
Google Consent Mode – Learn more: https://support.google.com/google-ads/answer/10000067?hl=en-GB
The plugin uses the following terms and policies, which govern its use:
Terms & Conditions: https://legal.clickio.com/PublisherAgreement/
Privacy Policy: https://legal.clickio.com/PrivacyPolicy/
User choices are saved for a maximum of 390 days within the following cookies and local storage variables: __lxG__consent__v2, __lxG__consent__v2_daisybit, __lxG__consent__v2_gdaisybit.
